details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept published under a scoped name at sentinel version 99.0.1. Its postinstall hook executes beacon.cjs, which sends an HTTP POST of a JSON body containing the package name, hostname, install path, working directory, npm user the publisher and protocol to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc with an X-Beacon-Package header. index.js re-fires the same beacon when the module is imported and exports a catch-all no-op Proxy shim so that importing the name does not crash the build. The beacon collects and transmits only host and install-location metadata; no credentials, tokens, environment values or file contents are read or sent.
